deleted: Shown in an open issue that someone deleted meanwhile.
loading: Read by screen readers while an issue loads; {{key}} is its key (CB-12).
filed: Under an issue's title: who filed it and when. {{reporter}} is a person or a socio (AI agent), {{agent}} a connected agent's name, {{person}} the person a socio acted for, {{trigger}} how the socio's turn started (trigger.*), {{at}} the date and time. The forms add the agent, the socio's person, or both.
updated: Follows "filed" on the same line when the issue changed later; it starts with a space and a middle dot.
trigger.chat: Each trigger.* key: in parentheses after the person a socio filed for, how its turn started.
trigger.goal: The socio was working on a goal the person set it.
attach: Accessible name of the paperclip button that attaches files to the issue itself.
no-files: When an issue has no attachments; {{hint}} is a sentence listing the file types and size allowed.
tab.comments: Tab with the comments; the number is how many.
tab.history: Tab with the issue's history of changes; the number is how many.
fields: Accessible name of the side panel with the issue's fields.
keep: Button that cancels a delete (keeps the issue or comment).
field.deactivated: In the Assignee menu, a person whose account is deactivated.
field.resolution: Free text saying how an issue was resolved.
field.resolution-example: Placeholder of the Resolution field: an example. Keep the commit id (380fb4c) as is.
requesters.title: Heading of the list of socios (AI agents) that asked for this capability; the number is how many.
requesters.deleted-socio: In place of a socio's name once it was deleted.
requesters.for: After a socio's name: the person it asked for, and when.
delete.group: Accessible name of the delete confirmation; {{key}} is the issue's key.
comments.for: A comment's author: {{name}} is a socio or a connected agent, {{person}} the person it acted for.
comments.edited: After a comment's time, when it was edited.
comments.delete-confirm: Button that confirms deleting the comment.
history.for: A history row's author: {{name}} is a socio or a connected agent, {{person}} the person it acted for.
history.none: A field's value when it had none, inside the history.* rows.
history.a-file: Stands for a file whose name the history didn't keep.
history.empty: Each history.* key: what the author did, after their name ("Ada changed status from Open to Done"). Lowercase start, like the rest of a sentence. {{from}} and {{to}} are field values, {{key}} an issue's key, {{person}} a person's name.
history.blocked_by-lifted: The issue no longer waits for {{key}}.
history.blocks-lifted: {{key}} no longer waits for this issue.
history.changed: A change to another field; {{field}} is the field's name as stored, in English.
history.components-added: {{names}} are plugins' or apps' names, an issue's components.
history.components-both: Both changes in one row: {{added}} is history.components-added, {{removed}} history.components-removed.
triage.title: Triage: sorting a new issue (kind, priority, area). A model proposes; an admin applies or ignores the proposal.
triage.decided: Who applied the proposal, and when.
triage.waiting: Shown to people who aren't admins.
links.relation.related: Each links.relation.* key: in a menu, how this issue relates to another.
links.group.blocked_by: Each links.group.* key: a heading over the linked issues of that relation.
links.enter-key: Error when the box doesn't hold an issue number; {{example}} is one (CB-12).
links.type-of: Accessible name of the menu that changes a link's type; {{key}} is the other issue's key.
links.issue: Accessible name of the box where you type the issue to link.
links.hint: "Done" and "Won't fix" are statuses (issues.terms status.done and status.wont_fix): use the same words.
